name: Battle Athletess Daiundoukai
original_name: バトルアスリーテス 大運動会
source:
Set in the year of 4998, after the war with an alien race, the battle is no longer waged with devastating weapons but through a contest of physical strength between representatives of each race. In Battle Athletes, Akari Kanzaki, the protagonist of the story, but not the player, is a daughter of a former Cosmic Beauty who promised her mother on her deathbed to follow in her steps. Akari enrolls in a training school and strives to shape her body and become the next Cosmic Beauty. 

The story progresses one day at the time, leaving you to go through a half-year long training with Akari. The player can go to various areas in the school, talk to other characters, and perform daily training routines such as running, swimming, aerobics, and more. As Akari trains more, her physical characteristics improve, such as stamina, endurance, strength, and other. To check Akari's current stats, you can visit the school nurse to give you a rundown on her current condition.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/sega-saturn/battle-athletes-daiundoukai]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
故事背景设定在4998年，与外星种族的战争结束后，战斗不再是毁灭性的武器，而是各个种族代表之间体力的较量。在《战斗运动员》中，故事的主角（而非玩家）神崎明里是前宇宙美人的女儿，她在临终前向母亲许诺会追随她的脚步。明里进入了一所培训学校，努力塑造自己的身材，成为下一个宇宙美人。

故事在某一天进展，让你和明里一起接受为期半年的训练。玩家可以前往学校的各个区域，与其他角色交谈，并进行日常训练，例如跑步、游泳、健美操等。随着明里训练的增加，她的身体特征得到改善，例如体力、耐力、力量等。要查看明里当前的统计数据，你可以拜访学校护士，向你简要介绍她当前的状况。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/sega-saturn/battle-athletes-daiundoukai]Moby Games[/url]]
